detected_fault: Intermittent BSOD crashes and random shutdowns
suggested_solution: Run FurMark and Cinebench 24 Multi to identify potential hardware issues.
Monitor system temperatures using G Helper or Armory Crate.
Adjust fan settings and voltage levels using ASUS ROG Boost or XG Boost.
Regularly update drivers and BIOS to ensure the latest security patches and performance enhancements.
